name: David Daniel
title: Software Engineer
tagline: I build scalable, reliable systems, from the backend services and APIs underneath to the interfaces people use every day.
summary: Full-stack software engineer with four years building, testing, and operating enterprise systems in Java, React/Next.js, TypeScript, C#/.NET, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB across a large multi-application platform. Owns services end to end — design, test-first development, AWS/Kubernetes deployment, and production support — and builds AI-assisted engineering tooling used daily. Strong focus on backend services, API integrations, database performance, legacy modernization, and reliable delivery.
earlierExperienceIntro: Before I wrote code, I spent 14 years in restaurants and customer service: running food at an Italian trattoria, managing a Dunkin’, taking Xbox support calls and working packed bars on Friday nights. Most engineers come to the job straight from a classroom. My path ran through busy dining rooms, where I learned to stay calm when everything lands at once, to explain a problem to someone who is frustrated, and to care whether the person on the other end leaves happy. That is the background I bring to every system I build: I build for the people who use it, and I do my best work under pressure.
